cs.t: If you want to check out that price range VR headset today, I recommend  https://varjo.com/products/xr-3/  Varjo XR-3 now available for €5495 + 1-year subscription for €1495.   Apple  likely aims to that level or better with smaller, lighter and more ergonomic design. They blow away anything Oculus, Sony, Valve/HTC offer. They are amazing, but I think there needs to be order of magnitude leap in technology before VR becomes commonplace. Apple probably targets that.
cs.th: Apple First VR Headset to Be Niche Precursor to Eventual AR Glasses
